{{Top|leg}}
'''Repulsorlift Assault Vehicle''' was a classification of [[Ground assault vehicle/Legends|Ground Assault Vehicle]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Repulsorlift Assault Vehicles included any [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-propelled vehicle such as the [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]], the [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|LAVr QH-7 Chariot]], and [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]].
